verdict.rationale: First-party docs show ChatGPT can schedule recurring tasks to run in the background. A 'Scheduled' view lets users review active, paused, and completed tasks and recent runs, and scheduled tasks can also start from Gmail, Slack, or GitHub events. This is a true recurring schedule, not a one-off action. missing for 10: documentation of cadence/schedule configuration options, independent or hands-on corroboration that recurring jobs run reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Schedule recurring tasks to run in the background... Review active, paused, and completed tasks and recent runs in Scheduled.
scheduled tasks can run when a supported Gmail, Slack, or GitHub event occurs
Use an event trigger to triage new email, summarize channel activity, or act on pull request feedback without polling on a fixed cadence.
